question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Flabby
solution:
The correct answer is '**Firm**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Flabby**' is '**Firm**'.
 
• **Flabby**: (of a part of a person's body) soft, loose, and fleshy; lacking strength, vitality, or effectiveness. (बहुत अधिक कोमल चरबी वाला; थुलथुल)
 
 
• *Example: a **flabby** stomach...*
 
 
 
• **Firm:** having a solid, almost unyielding surface or structure; quite hard. (सख्‍़त; सुदृढ़, काफ़ी कड़ा)
 
 
• *Example: a **firm** mattress...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Firm.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Long**: measuring or covering a large amount in distance or time. (दूरी या समय की बड़ी मात्रा में व्‍याप्‍त, दूर या लंबा)
 
• **Plump**: (used about a person or an animal) pleasantly fat. [(व्‍यक्ति या पशु) मोटा-ताज़ा, गोल-मटोल (जो देखने में अच्‍छा लगे)]
 
• **Stretched**: to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन)
